title: Move headers outside extern "C".
description: To allow newer compilers, e.g. GCC 10.3, build the C++ code without throwing errors such as "error: template specialization with ‘C’ linkage" and "error: conflicting declaration of ‘method’ with ‘C’ linkage"

notes.body:
added 4 commits
  • b22ebf28 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master-3.2
  • 7004d4fc - Move more headers outside extern "C".
  • 0e3747c6 - Move still *more* headers outside of extern "C".
  • ae21696a - Moving glib.h out of extern C
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/4536/diffs?diff_id=258866784&start_sha=0fd9797efdd699a91aef3707cbefb5b070f0ae73)
I'm broken on the inside, please somebody fix me... :cry:

commits_data.title: Move still *more* headers outside of extern "C".
commits_data.message:
Move still *more* headers outside of extern "C".

If a header declares a function, or anything else requiring the extern
"C" decoration, have it wrap the declaration itself; don't rely on the
header itself being included inside extern "C".

(cherry picked from commit 2820156fbd4b0213ca015216d8cd97c31b503c8c)
